groups.activity: earn a Death Mark, then meet Stalker

rows.label: Despair Blueprint
rows.note: 11.73% of a blueprint table that rolls half the time, from Stalker and Shadow Stalker; untradeable

alt.text: or a Stalker Beacon from Baro Ki'Teer forces the spawn, when he stocks it

conditions: Only the killing blow on an Assassination boss grants the mark, and aborting after the kill still counts. Corrupted Vor, Ropalolyst, Zealoid Prelate, The Fragmented and H-09 Efervon Tank give none.
Spawn chance is 1.5% + 0.5% per marked squad member, 2% solo and 3.5% with four marked. He only appears in roughly the first 5 minutes of a mission.
He cannot spawn in Assassinations, Syndicate missions, Sorties, Archon Hunts, Archwing, Landscapes, Albrecht's Laboratories, Höllvania, Dark Refractory or hubs.
Your Warframe must be rank 10 or higher.
A beacon is consumed on use, one per mission, so run it in a short mission.
bonuses: Hyena Pack (Psamathe, Neptune) and The Sergeant (Iliad, Phobos) are the fastest marks. Volt with Shocking Speed, Gauss or Titania burn through the Sergeant.
Stay marked through your normal missions: the best passive farm is meeting him on Sedna or Hydron runs you were doing anyway.

disclosures.title: why marks stack but odds do not
disclosures.body: A mark per different boss lets you chain encounters across missions, but the spawn roll is once per mission, so several marks in one mission do not lift the odds above 3.5%.

disclosures.title: squads of newer players
disclosures.body: Low-rank squads are constantly being marked, so playing with newer players reports the most encounters.
